text:
Maya R: Heads up — Crestline is seeing a 2x tail latency increase on chat gen since onboarding last week. Renewal check-in next month and they're noting cost vs latency. Can we propose quick perf levers?
Devon L: looking. any SLO details? what percentile? :mag_right:
Maya R: p95 rising from 180ms -> 380ms, p99 spikes to ~1.7s on long contexts. Traffic ~2.5k reqs/min. They're on hosted, US-west region.
Devon L: ok. quick wins: 1) enable int8 quant on the Llama-variant canary 2) route non-critical requests to compact-variant (llama-compact-v1) 3) prefix KV caching for repeated system prompts. should shave 20-40% cost and ~30-50% tail.
Eli S: +1. Need to validate quality delta for critical flows. Recommend A/B canary (5% traffic), collect Rouge/accuracy on eval set.
Jordan P: sounds good. I'll message the customer to get signoff for a low-risk canary. Can we bundle the playbook so I can share?
Devon L: creating canary now. plan:
```
route_policy:
  - name: crestline-canary-int8
    match: "path:chat and user_tier:free"
    percent: 5
    model: "llama-compact-int8-v1"
    fallback: "llama-2.1-full"
```
We need an automatic fallback to full-precision for requests that fail quality checks.
Rina (CSM): They called out exactness on summaries for billing docs — must be kept in canary validation. I'll upload 20 representative prompts to Optimize evals.
InfraBot: Canary deployment started on dedicated-gpu-pool-usw2 — 2 nodes. Deployment ID: dep-48f3
Devon L: also watch queue depth — enable adaptive batching with max_batch=8 and latency_slo_ms=400 for this route.
Eli S: capture these metrics: p95/p99 latency, token-cost-per-response, eval regression rate, fallback rate.
Jordan P: timeline?
Maya R: canary goes live today EOD. Jordan to confirm customer signoff by noon. Rina to push eval prompts by 11:30. Devon/Eli to monitor for 48h. I'll prep renewal touchpoint slide with expected cost delta.
Rina (CSM): I'll add a note to the account health doc and flag renewal risk 'moderate' until we see numbers.
Devon L: if quality drops >1.5% on key metric, auto rollback to full precision and alert #eng-runtime.
Eli S: I'll wire up a regression alert in Optimize:
`if regression_rate > 0.015 then notify #customer-success and rollback`
Jordan P: thanks team. tagging @Finance (FYI) for cost delta. :memo:
Maya R: great. next check-in 48h post-canary. Thanks all :rocket:
